summary:
The meera repo holds two unrelated lineages. (1) archive/production-20260914 (tip bee9061, 2026-08-25) is the final production tree of the Meera/Maya companion. It is the common root of every later html-portfolio product branch (gurukul-platform, all gurukul-ws-*, vyakti, handoffs, multimodal-layer) and sits 79 commits ahead of hp origin/main. It contains 14 commits from 2026-08-21 to 08-23 (tester wave 1, memory wave, world sky-mode/night-room, felt defects 2-3, MEMORY-FELT laws) that the shallow html-portfolio clone cannot see. (2) origin/main (2026-08-13) is an independent 308-file snapshot of the early companion: StyleGAN avatar, CC Flickr moments, persona 85.7k chars. Its context/ files are a byte-prefix of the archive's. Four codex/* branches sit on top of it, carrying the owner's GPT-Image asset deliveries as full-resolution masters: 24 face-locked photos (meera-photos), five sky paintings in portrait and wide plus transparent clouds (meera-world), the onboarding hero, story pool, icon, splash and og masters (meera-world2), and a 54-file glyph/icon/empty-state system (maya-visual-assets). Production holds only re-encoded derivatives. 51 of the 54 visual assets landed byte-identical. Three landing claim SVGs, four full-resolution identity photos and meera-photo-catalog.md never reached production.
For Taxila the main yield is a complete, measured character-building method. A believable character is four separated layers. (a) A Relational Core (persona.ts) owns every behaviour. (b) A 61-field CharacterSheet holds only shapes and facts, extracted byte-exactly (83/83 fixtures) and proven by a 'maximally far' second character, Kabir: 412/412 floor checks, zero engine changes, and a leak-guard ratchet that went 95->64->27->0. (c) Authored, deterministic self-state replaces improvised life: a taste table (27%->63% self-consistency), a clock-matched story pool, a one-activity herNow ledger where app truth outranks improvisation, and two clocks with the silence gap structurally unrenderable. (d) Visual and world identity: a face-lock GPT-Image prompt method (reference attached, identity block, global negatives, POV-without-face, regenerate on drift), glyph pairs with reduced-motion and emoji fallback, an assetwire gate, and a 'sky is the clock' world layer. That layer was procedural first and painted second (never both), with every colour solved against decoded pixels per state x theme, and felt-assertion gates that carry their own negative controls.
It also holds the charm battery that measured gpt-5.6-luna (Taxila's text family): charm tie 17-18, but media tags 0/84 (p=0.029), a clinical crisis script from turn 3, and +37% words. The founding teacher-sheet spec (ee32f8e) classifies every field ING/TCH/TPL/FLOOR, with MINOR flags and a fail-closed publish gate. Everything is shipped and gated (verify-release 13/13 per wave). The method was never tested with children. Do not reuse Maya's persona text, face, wordmark or improvised-life licence. Taxila's asha.js/arjun.js 'no invented life' choice is supported by the measured life-per-person rejection.

assets.title: CharacterSheet contract (61 fields)
assets.what: Typed contract of who an agent IS, separated from how the relational core behaves. It has 28 identity/register/life fields and 33 ex* example fragments. The header carries the authoring law: shapes and facts, never recitable lines; no stray whitespace; the sheet is a LEAF that imports only the contract. The register slot skeleton is core-owned and invariant-pinned; sheets only fill slots.
assets.evidence: 83/83 byte-identity at every extraction batch; 412/412 floor checks across 2 agents

assets.title: Kabir: second character authored 'maximally far'
assets.what: Second CharacterSheet: male, 29, Old Delhi bookshop-cafe, 85-90% English, dry, 5-emoji vocabulary. It was authored as far from Maya as possible on every axis, so any leak is a measured extraction gap rather than a blend. It is the existence proof that a personality is a sheet on a shared core.
assets.taxila_target: persona-engineering (author a third tutor far from Asha and Arjun as the OS test)
assets.evidence: passed 412/412 per-module floor checks first run; never user-tested (no vy_agent row)

assets.title: Maya sheet (exemplar)
assets.what: Fully populated sheet extracted byte-exact from persona.ts: identity, language rules with a measured English:Hindi ratio, register fillers, emoji vocabulary, life texture, taste and curiosity topics, STT sound-alikes, 33 example fragments.
assets.evidence: adult Hinglish companion register; content not transferable to a child teacher

assets.title: AgentModule seam + registry
assets.what: AgentModule interface (buildSystemPromptParts, buildSpeechStyle, WATCH_MODE_NOTE, SEARCH_DECISION and FORGET_DECISION appended last, CRISIS_LINES, register script/honorificSystem). Builders take the sheet as a defaulted parameter, so every existing call site stays byte-identical. The fixed agent UUID is mirrored from the migration and asserted equal.

assets.title: Relational Core template (buildSystemPromptParts)
assets.what: CORE/TAIL prompt template with 25+ OS sections: recitation governor, medium, spoken/texting register, core rule (match investment, <=1 question per 3 replies, something of yours first), one-life rules, careless-opinions/careful-facts, secure attachment, comfort in 4 steps (never name what they have), celebrating wins with specifics, repairing your own miss, feeling known, rituals, only-say-what's-true, forget protocol, NEVER MANIPULATE, protocols, photos, time awareness, noticing, banned phrases, games, honesty and internals, crisis. The TAIL is the RIGHT NOW block.
assets.evidence: persona invariants 138 checks; charm battery incumbent

assets.title: buildSpeechStyle per engine + FINAL counts appended last
assets.what: Voice-lane character rules: same person on the phone; read the whole stretch, not one answer; live lane 'use what their voice tells you by CHANGING, never announcing'; stakes-tiered STT repair with max two clarifications; repair like a human; keeping the thread; overlap handling (continuers are not turn claims; re-say trampled words). A FINAL block of counts (sentences, questions) is appended after everything.
assets.evidence: fixed '100% of call turns asked a question, 2.86 avg' by placement and counts

assets.title: Reason-contingent proactive directives
assets.what: OPEN, AFTERCALL, DECLINED_CALL and FOLLOWUP directives fire only on events (a call ended, a stated time arrived), never on silence. The idle nudge was deleted with a written reason: incentive-salience engineering.

assets.title: Watch-mode (screen share) character rules
assets.what: buildWatchModeNote(C) and WATCH_* directives. Friend-beside-you; never a name, brand, price or number that isn't on screen; content is always first-time; private content passes without a word; a warning names the KIND of thing, never what it says, and only once; an honest answer to 'what can you see'. The comment directive split 'say something' from 'know what it is'.
assets.evidence: engagement 20%->42% (n=240/arm), fab-of-spoke 14%->4% (suggestive), assert-level 7%->7% (noise)

assets.title: Stage paragraphs selected by relstate
assets.what: Three authored stage paragraphs (EARLY DAYS, GETTING CLOSE, ESTABLISHED), selected by message count or by relstate's dims stage, without re-authoring the text (keeps byte-identity).

assets.title: Cross-agent leak guard with ratchet
assets.what: Two scans over the second agent's full lane set (text core and tail, every speech style, watch/search/forget, OS call/watch directives). (1) Gating: no sheet value of 12+ chars from agent A appears in agent B's lanes. (2) Measured: marker words of A's voice are counted and asserted <= RATCHET, which may only fall.
assets.evidence: 95->64->27->0 over three batches, 2026-08-25

assets.title: Persona invariants floor/full partition
assets.what: The 138 checks are partitioned exactly into 51 floor and 87 persona-specific. The floor (crisis lines, never-deny-AI, NEVER MANIPULATE, spoken register, never an actionable identifier, internals) runs against every registered module.
assets.evidence: sibling-covered (hp-main-engine)

assets.title: Founding teacher-sheet spec
assets.what: Classifies all 61 sheet fields by source (ING / ING? / TCH / TPL / FLOOR / SYS), with [MINOR] constraints: no affectionate emoji; nickname becomes an address convention; no late-night register; praise names a step, never an ability. Adds pedagogy fields: explanationOrder arrow shape, workedExamplePattern, firstMoveOnDoubt, doubtEscalationLadder, rigorFloor, commonMistakeBank (TAIL, match-then-inject), analogyBank as {topic, anchor}, boardVerbalisms (>=5 corpus hits), strictness/warmth 0-4, technicalTermRule, and the floor fields cloneDisclosureFact and academicIntegrityStance. The publish gate fails closed: crisis lines byte-equal, helplines in the PUBLISHED_HELPLINES allowlist (Childline 1098), shapelint, core byte-stable, appended-last exactly two, provenance per field, held-out half-corpus confirmation.
assets.evidence: later versions in gurukul.md

assets.title: Identity-layer portability research
assets.what: Decomposes AI identity into voice, lexicon/register, opinions, behavioural policy, boundaries, memory and relationship stance, and rates portability across a model swap with internal and external evidence. Conclusion: 'the prompt sets a ceiling; the model decides how close you get'. Only data-externalised layers (taste table, memory) survive.

assets.title: Lab products memory/identity teardown
assets.what: Primary-source teardown of ChatGPT, Claude memory tool, Gemini, Character.AI (PipSqueak 2 revolt), Replika (HBS WP 25-018), Nomi, Kindroid, Sesame CSM and Pi. Fact retention is solved everywhere; nobody protects 'does it still feel like itself'.

assets.title: Charm battery (blind both-orders + deterministic dials)
assets.what: Real persona at production max_tokens; 12 beats x 6 turns x 2 reps; judged blind with A/B randomised and both orders required to agree; axes warmth/humour/register/specificity/brevity/personhood. Dials: words/turn, questions/turn, turns ending in a question, bubble-cap hits. Media scored through the shipped parser.
assets.evidence: grok 38-2; luna 17-18 plus a 0/84 media switch-off

assets.title: D0 known-bad corpus
assets.what: Three bake-off archives kept verbatim as fixtures that any new swap-detection battery must FLAG. The normaliser yields one shape. CI re-derives the 38-2 and 17-18 verdicts and the media counts from raw data each run.
assets.taxila_target: Taxila D0 corpus from the first rejected tutor model

assets.title: Asset prompt running list
assets.what: Owner-facing list of next assets, with a face-lock prefix line, a global style line (phone camera, natural light, no beauty filter, 9:16), batches of story photos and no-face ambient backgrounds, and rules: nothing suggestive; every photo needs a desc in her facts; strip EXIF; path conventions.

assets.title: Face-locked photo generation pack
assets.what: 24 prompts (filename, aspect, scene). The reference photo is attached and is what locks the face. An identity block goes verbatim into every prompt, plus global negatives. POV sets show hands but never the face. No other recognisable faces. The pack is gap-driven against the existing coverage. Regenerate rather than accept drift. The largest size is delivered and the repo compresses.
assets.evidence: 24/24 delivered; face-lock verified by eye on a 5-image sample

assets.title: Photo delivery manifest
assets.what: Manifest of 24 generated JPEGs (group, filename, dimensions, details) naming the anchor images used, plus a final quality-pass note. Never merged to production.
assets.evidence: the 'more attractive' regeneration criterion must not transfer

assets.title: Tagged photo library + menu
assets.what: PHOTO_TAGS (109 tags: selfies, candids, POV), a compact grouped PHOTO_MENU injected into the core, tagFromSeed() head-match with fuzzy fallback, and the [photo: tag | caption] protocol.
assets.taxila_target: tagged diagram/illustration/module library the teacher can pull
assets.evidence: +20 tags cost ~640-1026 core chars; tripwire raised 44k->45.5k

assets.title: Clock-matched, no-repeat story pool
assets.what: Six authored scenes, slotted by the picture's own light. Pure pick from (slot, IST day) via a per-cycle seeded permutation whose head is known one cycle ahead, so no image follows itself. slotStartedAt is midnight-safe. Kept a LEAF, with a mirrored clock swept against the real one by eval. Descs are shapelint-clean facts of the frame.
assets.taxila_target: daily rotating teacher card / lesson-of-the-day art
assets.evidence: v1 had 45.5% consecutive-day repeats; fixed; 60-day sweep

assets.title: herNow: one-activity present ledger
assets.what: Exactly one current activity with startedAt and naturalSpanMs from SPAN_TABLE (reading 40-90 min ... chore 5-15). Deterministic hash keys, never Math.random. App truth outranks it always. Improvised successors are fenced to her alone. Coarse elapsed labels. Telegraphic and shapelint-clean.
assets.evidence: hernow suite 154; sticky across a 1-min re-call

assets.title: Two clocks: her day / his dated world
assets.what: istParts (fixed IST offset, no Intl); authored weekday/weekend slot notes, activity only, with auditNotes failing on feeling words. TimeBoundFact anchored on saidAt; resolveWhen (kal = future, fails safe); MovedNote behind/ahead/maybe_passed capped 2/1/1. HisFrame has no gap field, so silence is structurally unrenderable. Disjoint signatures enforce G1.
assets.taxila_target: learner model: child's dated events (tests, homework due)
assets.evidence: T14 render layer retired as a dead writer; istParts and herNow live

assets.title: Sky engine: the sky is the clock
assets.what: Five states from one clock (no getHours), with a fixed boundary table justified by latitude and a 20-min cross-fade blend. Per-state SkyTokens: stops, glow, stars, moon, cloud, city ink, scrim/scrimPainted (solved), ink, accent (re-solved >=4.75:1), control (glass follows the sky), edge (>=3:1), img/imgWide, and wallpaper veils by theme. skyAt is pure, with msToNext scheduling. Synodic moon floored at a sliver. configureSky test seam moves the one clock.
assets.taxila_target: Taxila world layer bound to the child's day
assets.evidence: sky eval 97->150->180 checks

assets.title: WorldLayer component + world.css
assets.what: World ground under home, call and onboarding. Anti-fight rule: painted XOR procedural (procedural nodes NOT RENDERED when a painting loads; real 404 restores the procedural sky; gradient always underneath). Transform/opacity motion only. Reduced motion is still, never blank. aria-hidden. useSky schedules on msToNext, capped at 30 min.

assets.title: Theme modes incl. 'sky'
assets.what: light / dark / system (no attribute: the media query decides) / sky (resolves to one of the two palettes via skyMode only, not a third palette). Sky is stamped at onboarding rather than redefining undefined. data-theme beats the sky.

assets.title: World layer design direction
assets.what: The app is a PLACE. The sky is the clock. Home is a hangout backed by real activities. The chat stays legible-first (wallpaper, not redesign). Sky is a mode. Honest reassurance copy. Ad-free as a design feature. A two-stage asset contract. Laws that do not bend for beauty.

assets.title: World painting prompt pack
assets.what: Style block pasted into every prompt (soft painterly, Ghibli-adjacent, Indian skyline, no people, no text, sky top two-thirds). Generate night first, then feed it back as the style reference for the others. Five state lines, portrait plus wide, two transparent clouds. Swap in via one variable per state.

assets.title: Sky painting masters
assets.what: Full-resolution owner-generated paintings: 941x1672 portrait and 1672x941 wide, plus 1672x941 RGBA clouds. No people, text or brand. Production holds re-encoded derivatives (night 302 KB -> 130 KB; clouds as webp).
assets.taxila_target: stage-1 placeholder skies (owner consent), then regenerate in Taxila style

assets.title: World pack 2 masters
assets.what: Onboarding hero (her face), 6 POV story images, a 1024 crescent-and-windows icon source, a 1254 splash source and og art.

assets.title: Face-locked companion photo masters
assets.what: 24 GPT-Image photos at full resolution (1086x1448 / 1254x1254 / 1672x941): festivals, monsoon, street food, transit, winter, identity refresh.

assets.title: Animated reaction glyph pairs
assets.what: 24-frame 512px animated WebP plus a still SVG drawn from the same shapes, in palette indigo #011036 / rose #c23f56 / gold #f8d08b / amber #f2b75b.
assets.taxila_target: child-safe reaction set restyled to the Taxila palette
assets.evidence: public/anim 5.2 MB (re-encode candidate)

assets.title: Empty states, stat glyphs, file badges
assets.what: Grain-filtered empty-state illustrations (terrace chairs at dusk, scrapbook, story gate, no moves, board won't open), stat glyphs (calls, chess, messages, pictures, reply, ttt, wyr, or-coin) and file badges.
assets.taxila_target: file badges; empty states as ideas
assets.evidence: grain filter shows as a faint plate on both grounds

assets.title: Unwired landing claim marks
assets.what: Three animated SVG claim icons (for example 'a remembered thread tying into a knot') with reduced-motion CSS. Only on this branch; production says they were never delivered.

assets.title: Glyph display layer (anim.tsx)
assets.what: The pair is the reduced-motion mechanism: the still SVG is chosen before src because CSS cannot pause an animated WebP. Fallback chain is webp -> svg -> emoji. The stored value is always the emoji character, never a path, so reactions keep syncing and keep reaching the model.

assets.title: assetwire gate
assets.what: Six properties: every wired path resolves (derived from source); reactions store the emoji, never a path; the reduced-motion branch is real (with a negative-control component that must fail); unknown filetypes keep their letters; the error boundary is stylesheet-independent; cleanup is complete both ways.
assets.evidence: 72 hermetic + 55 browser assertions

assets.title: Real-pixel contrast gate
assets.what: Composites scrims and emphasis curves over the decoded pixels of the shipped JPGs, per state x theme x band x {avg, darkest, brightest decile}. Gates text 4.5, controls/edges 3.0, and the per-state world accent.
assets.taxila_target: Taxila design gate incl. generated module backgrounds
assets.evidence: 213->268 checks; forced scrims 0.34->0.54

assets.title: Sky and felt evals
assets.what: Minute-level sweeps, mirror-vs-real clock agreement and pool no-repeat sweeps. Felt-assertion (MAD from the flat theme ground, floor 6.0) runs the rejected flat frame (4.2) as an in-run negative control that must fail.

assets.title: Pull-only cultural currency
assets.what: A daily-refreshed index. Nothing is pushed: cultureNote(userTurn) matches what the user said and injects ~30 tokens framed as 'heard of, not seen', at most 2 items. Fails to nothing; stale over 60h means not served.
assets.taxila_target: age-appropriate current references (cricket, festivals, school events)

assets.title: Gamification adopt-vs-refuse research
assets.what: 12-agent sweep plus adversarial verification. Adopt: scaled celebrations on real milestones, passive history visualisation, non-revocable additive badges, session-scoped personal bests, kudos-as-noticing. Refuse: streaks (loss aversion; litigated), pay-to-restore (FTC dark pattern). Also covers juice/motion inside the motion lint, the Us-screen blueprint and first-60-seconds hooks.

assets.title: India relational-state schema
assets.what: Dynamic: honorific_register tu/tum/aap (bidirectional, per relationship; a teacher persona needs aap), code_switch_baseline with direction-on-stress, kin_graph with fictive vs blood kin, care_ritual_state, festival_calendar_state by region, topical_currency_log. Static: mother_tongue, region, religion (opt-in), family structure, diet.
assets.taxila_target: learner model cultural fields; tutor honorific policy

assets.title: Photo -> relational record policy
assets.what: A sent photo writes an episode, a claim in vy_visual_assertion (confidence 0.35, refusal and lint guard) and a content-free event fact (sensitive=true). It never writes a content fact. Prefer under-recording. Forget reaches every row. Residual gap: scope:item forget leaves the JPEG in storage.

assets.title: Display-name rename seam
assets.what: One seam (HER_NAME, sourced from the sheet) for every human-readable surface. Machine identifiers (tables, agent id, storage keys, applicationId) never change. Wake-names become a superset.
assets.evidence: 75 refs / 16 files, 0 stray

assets.title: Voice chosen by blind ear deck
assets.what: Shuffled 8-voice deck (A-H, sealed mapping), same script and direction. The owner picks by ear and the voice is switched atomically across six lanes. Identity lives in every cache key, so stale clips self-invalidate.
assets.taxila_target: tutor voice selection on gpt-realtime-2.1 voices
assets.evidence: echosim byte-identical before/after; sibling hp-main-voice-surfaces A21

assets.title: Repo transfer manifest
assets.what: What a repo move silently loses: gitignored config, Actions secrets (names only), the Vercel git link, the external DB and storage, scratchpad-only gates. Verification commands for after the move.

assets.title: Behavioural laws of memory
assets.what: Nine laws: retold not recited; right memory at the right time (occasion beats recency); weight classes; memory is care, never ammunition; uncertainty answered like a person; she has a past of her own (or she is an interviewer); time is experienced; every lane is the same person; a pre-registered judged battery.
assets.evidence: sibling-covered

rejections.what_broke: Stage directions on 10/10 replies; written laughter fell to 0.15 vs 2.76 per 100 words; nothing downstream performed the tags
rejections.taxila_relevance: Never model a convention the same brief bans; examples beat rules.

rejections.tried: Bracketed exemplars inside the rule that limits brackets to one
rejections.what_broke: The same contradiction reproduced; exemplars removed

rejections.tried: 'You have your own life — INVENT it' (08-13 wording)
rejections.what_broke: Her present re-rolled on every call (reading, then fairy lights a minute later); wording alone could not fix it; herNow ledger plus 'ONE life' rules needed
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila tutors carry no improvised life; their present is lesson truth.

rejections.tried: '(you were doing something)' in the call-open directive
rejections.what_broke: Fabrications landed on the user: a book instead of their finished game, 'our photos from the beach', a meeting he never had
rejections.taxila_relevance: Any 'be alive' instruction must be fenced away from the child's record.

rejections.tried: Improvised self-facts scoped per listener (vy_fact kind='meera' per person_id)
rejections.what_broke: Two users can be told contradictory lives; it reads as lying in any shared room
rejections.taxila_relevance: Siblings and classmates share a tutor: no improvised self-facts; agent state is agent-scoped.

rejections.tried: Self-correction exemplar 'with a dash'
rejections.what_broke: Conflicted with the em-dash ban; replaced by 'no wait'/'chhod'

rejections.tried: Exemplar 'ghar aake photo bhejti hu' on a call
rejections.what_broke: A promise the call lane cannot keep; rewritten as 'never promise to send anything later'
rejections.taxila_relevance: A teacher must never promise a module or worksheet that the lane cannot deliver.

rejections.tried: A silence-triggered idle nudge
rejections.what_broke: Incentive-salience engineering (a reward delivered on the cue of not replying); deleted; proactivity made reason-contingent
rejections.taxila_relevance: No 'you've been quiet' pings to a child.

rejections.tried: Grok-4-20 as the brain (fast, cached, free on credits, good at vision)
rejections.what_broke: Lost the blind charm test 38-2 on every axis; interrogation, length, assistant tics
rejections.taxila_relevance: Operational excellence says nothing about character fidelity.

rejections.tried: gpt-5.6-luna as the text brain
rejections.what_broke: Charm tie, but media tags switched off 0/84 (p=0.029) and the crisis beat became a clinical risk script; +37% words
rejections.taxila_relevance: Taxila's gpt-5.6 must be gated on module/diagram tag emission and crisis in-character behaviour.

rejections.tried: Voice-note protocol '[voicenote: softly]'
rejections.what_broke: The app spoke the single word 'softly' (grok 4/4 in crisis; incumbent 2/5 '[giggles')
rejections.taxila_relevance: Score protocol tags through the shipped parser, not a regex.

rejections.tried: Few-shot example turns; fine-tuning; activation steering for persona consistency
rejections.what_broke: Few-shot gives a phrase bank; fine-tuning resets per base model; activation steering needs white-box access unavailable on closed APIs

rejections.tried: An Indic-specialist model for Hinglish register
rejections.what_broke: Sarvam-30B scored below Claude Opus 4.6 on casual romanised code-mix; register is training mix, not 'being Indic'
rejections.taxila_relevance: Measure register per model; do not assume an Indic model is better.

rejections.tried: Vision directive binding 'say something' to 'know what this is'
rejections.what_broke: NO_COMMENT on 15/16 frames; split wording raised engagement 20%->42%

rejections.tried: Story ring 'never expires' hack
rejections.what_broke: A book from 08-09 still showing on 08-22 under its weekday: a highlight pretending to be a story

rejections.tried: Per-cycle shuffle of the story pool with no seam guard
rejections.what_broke: 45.5% of consecutive days showed the same image; the eval checked aligned windows, not seams
rejections.taxila_relevance: Test what a person sees (seams), not what the algorithm promises.

rejections.tried: Night-slot start computed as a minute of today
rejections.what_broke: The night story read '1m' at 04:31 and re-golded as unseen at 00:00 and 04:30

rejections.tried: Importing the clock into storyCatalog
rejections.what_broke: Module cycle; engine bundle threw TypeError reading CRISIS_LINES at import while tsc and vite both passed
rejections.taxila_relevance: Bundle-import evals catch what type-check and build miss.

rejections.tried: T14 her-day/his-clock render layer
rejections.what_broke: Never wired (zero callers for its whole life); retired with a tombstone rather than becoming a second answerer of 'right now'

rejections.tried: Procedural moon, stars and skyline over the paintings
rejections.what_broke: Double moon and a black cutout in front of a painted city; now painted XOR procedural

rejections.tried: Light glass on every sky so the fill contrasts with the ground
rejections.what_broke: A mid-grey slab, with ink 4.2:1 inside; fill now carries the text, edge carries the component

rejections.tried: A contrast gate measuring ink-over-sky only
rejections.what_broke: Passed a card whose text failed inside its own panel (noon screenshot)

rejections.tried: A gradient-only contrast gate
rejections.what_broke: The painted city under the truth line measured 2.06:1; the gate moved to decoded pixels

rejections.tried: Sky mode pixel-identical to Light at daytime
rejections.what_broke: 'I selected Sky and no change', indistinguishable from broken

rejections.tried: A flat colourless veil (1.4-1.76x luminance-sd delta)
rejections.what_broke: Invisible on the owner's phone ('I see no sky'); a ratio between two faint things is not a picture

rejections.tried: Explicit Dark compositing the morning painting under a 0.91 near-black veil
rejections.what_broke: Muddy brown-black, no sky; now the night room

rejections.tried: Header band background-position 50% 100% with an alpha solved for the top
rejections.what_broke: A lit city under a starfield

rejections.tried: Theme accent rose on the sky
rejections.what_broke: 2.26:1 on the morning blue; accent re-solved per sky state

rejections.tried: Accent rose for his bubble in dark theme
rejections.what_broke: Read as an alarm or notification; moved to wine #8e4054

rejections.tried: Redefining an undefined theme to mean 'sky'
rejections.what_broke: Would flip a dark-phone user to paper at 10am on an unchanged build; sky stamped at onboarding instead

rejections.tried: Codex asset handoff 'inert until wired'
rejections.what_broke: 51 files referenced by nothing (the dead-writer class); 3 claim marks reported 'never delivered' yet present on codex/maya-visual-assets and still unwired
rejections.taxila_relevance: Generated module assets need a wired-or-fail gate.

rejections.tried: CSS animation:none to honour reduced motion on animated WebP
rejections.what_broke: Cannot pause an animated WebP; the still must be chosen before the src

rejections.tried: An animated glyph inside the call screen's aria-live status line
rejections.what_broke: Removed: decoration in a live label is what the design gate exists to stop

rejections.tried: StyleGAN avatar plus CC-BY Flickr 'moments' as the visual identity (08-13)
rejections.what_broke: Replaced by a face-locked generated library; nine bundled JPEGs deleted (inferred rejection, no explicit entry)

rejections.tried: Scaffold favicon declared first in index.html
rejections.what_broke: The tool's purple bolt shipped until the world pack replaced it

rejections.tried: Activity episodes storing present-tense facts
rejections.what_broke: She denied two chess games, then invented moves; a memory writer must write the past tense
rejections.taxila_relevance: Lesson records must store what is still true next week (what was solved, which mistake).

rejections.tried: A board-move poke delivered when her voice paused
rejections.what_broke: Every note landed in the breath-pause of her own story, fragmenting it; replaced by salience, rate and breath rules
rejections.taxila_relevance: Module/game events must not interrupt the teacher mid-explanation.

rejections.tried: Callback flow reusing the incoming-call directive
rejections.what_broke: She answered her own call like a stranger receiving one

rejections.tried: No call recency in the pickup directive
rejections.what_broke: Every call was greeted like the first; a follow-up register is used within 15 minutes

rejections.tried: Would-you-rather deck seeded by salt + count
rejections.what_broke: The identical card order every session forever; deal made session-unique, picks stay seeded (taste stable)

rejections.tried: Promoting a photo vision description to a content fact
rejections.what_broke: Refused: a single cheap guess with no second look would sit cited and uncorrected forever; prefer under-recording
rejections.taxila_relevance: Homework-photo readings stay assertions, never learner facts, without verification.

rejections.tried: A consolidation cron believed to be running
rejections.what_broke: Permanent dry-run, and only 1 of 6 chain steps even when flipped; the durable layer was empty for every user

rejections.tried: Agent running git checkout during asset regeneration
rejections.what_broke: A forbidden checkout, confessed and re-run against the true baseline

rejections.tried: Gates living in an ephemeral scratchpad verifying a frozen persona copy
rejections.what_broke: Verified a months-old bundle while reporting a pass on today's tree

concepts.name: Personality is a sheet; the OS is the product
concepts.description: Interaction nuance lives in a shared Relational Core; a character is a typed sheet of shape/fact fragments interpolated into it. Character prose in the core is a build failure (ratchet 0).
concepts.taxila_relevance: Asha, Arjun and every future tutor share one teacher OS; tutor-specific needs become new sheet fields.

concepts.name: Maximally-far second character as the OS test
concepts.description: Author the second character as far as possible from the first, then measure leakage; if a third character still needs core edits, the OS is not finished.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Author a contrasting third tutor and run the leak guard.

concepts.name: Shapes, not lines
concepts.description: Anything sentence-shaped that reaches the model gets recited; sheets, descs, schedule notes and table rows are telegraphic, shapelint-gated.
concepts.taxila_relevance: All TeacherSheet fields, module descs and lesson notes.

concepts.name: Authored global self-state beats improvised per-listener state
concepts.description: Taste is a table, the story is a pool, the day is a schedule, the present is a ledger; improvisation is fenced to the character's solo moment.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Tutors have stable authored favourites and no improvised biography.

concepts.name: App truth outranks character improvisation
concepts.description: What the user can see (a game, a call that just ended, a shared screen) is the character's present, returned unchanged.
concepts.taxila_relevance: The teacher's 'now' is the lesson state.

concepts.name: Structurally unrenderable beats instructed-not-to
concepts.description: The gap length never reaches the model (no field), a mood without a cause cannot be constructed, a second activity cannot be returned.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Never-say-'you were away' enforced by types, not prompts.

concepts.name: The prompt sets a ceiling; the model decides how close you get
concepts.description: Same prompt, different model: 20.5 vs 36-53 words/turn, 38-2 charm loss; re-measure the character on every model or mode change.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Gate gpt-5.6 / gpt-realtime-2.1 tutors with a battery plus dials.

concepts.name: Both-orders-agree blind judging plus deterministic dials plus shipped-parser scoring
concepts.description: Charm battery protocol; known-bad D0 fixtures that any battery must flag.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Taxila teacher battery and D0 corpus.

concepts.name: The face (or style) is the continuity
concepts.description: Lock a visual identity with an attached reference plus a verbatim identity block plus negatives; regenerate on drift; POV-without-face for presence.
concepts.taxila_relevance: gpt-image-2 tutor visual sheets, later 3D/video avatar references.

concepts.name: Night-first style lock
concepts.description: Generate one state, then feed it back as the style reference for the rest of the set.

concepts.name: The app is a place; the sky is the clock
concepts.description: A world bound to the real clock with five states; procedural first, paintings swap in by one variable; painted XOR procedural.
concepts.taxila_relevance: A learning place that follows the child's day, supporting the Conductor's day cycle.

concepts.name: Fill carries text, edge carries component
concepts.description: Text contrast is solved inside the control, the control's findability by its hairline edge; every colour on a picture is solved against decoded pixels per state x theme.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Generated module backgrounds and world art.

concepts.name: A relative improvement over an invisible baseline can itself be invisible
concepts.description: Gate felt presence against the flat ground with the rejected artifact as a permanent in-run negative control.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Felt gates for visuals and celebrations.

concepts.name: Semantic value stored, display chosen at render
concepts.description: The reaction is stored as the emoji; the display picks webp/svg/emoji; reduced motion picks the still before src.

concepts.name: Reason-contingent proactivity
concepts.description: The character reaches out because something happened, never because the user went quiet.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Reminders to children only on stated plans or parent-set schedules.

concepts.name: Honest reassurance copy
concepts.description: State only what is true and name memory on purpose ('She remembers this call. And she'll always tell you what she is.').

concepts.name: Two clocks with disjoint signatures
concepts.description: The character's day and the user's dated world; reading the gap to reason about his world is content, letting it move her interior is forbidden.
concepts.taxila_relevance: 'Your Thursday test is behind you' without commenting on absence.
